name: Guess the Word
author: Addicting Games
description: Challenge your vocabulary and problem-solving skills with Guess The Word! In this exciting word puzzle, guess a hidden five-letter word using color-coded hints—green for correct letters, yellow for misplaced ones, and grey for wrong letters. Refine your guesses and solve the puzzle! With a vast collection of words, this game sharpens your linguistic abilities while keeping you engaged. Whether you're a word game enthusiast or just looking for a fun brain workout, Guess The Word is the perfect choice. Play now to enhance your vocabulary, boost your pattern recognition, and enjoy hours of entertaining word-solving fun!
